{{Quote|One of their leaders, a crimelord, is taking charge and instructing his cronies to cause havoc on our beloved Space Station. There is no telling what terrible feats they are capable of.|[[Rydel Delan]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GRC" />}}
'''Genesis Red''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], leader of the [[Genesis Red (gang)|eponymous criminal organization]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he participated in the gang's occupation of portions of the lower levels of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:GRC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the renegades were planning to sabotage Tansarii Point Station. They managed to broke through the outer hull of the station, creating a very dangerous situation for its inhabitants.<ref name="SWG:GRC" /> Fortunately, their plans were thwarted by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for [[Rydel Delan]], Tansarii Point's [[Unarmed combat/Legends|brawling]] master. A large number of their thugs and saboteurs were killed by the spacers and agents of the Tansarii Point Station authorities.<ref name="SWG:T">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Tiarsis|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> Genesis Red himself was amongst those killed by the hired spacers, as requested by Rydel Delant to definitely eliminate the criminal syndicate.<ref name="SWG:GRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Minnet.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Genesis Red.]]
Genesis Red was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GRC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Genesis Red was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]," introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

Genesis Red should be killed by the player as part of a [[W:c:swg:Genesis Red Crimelord|quest]] given by Rydel Delan. This NPC had no canon species as he respawned with a random appearance each time he was killed. While he could also respawn as a female, Rydel Delan stated Genesis Red was a male.<ref name="SWG:GRC" />
